build_GeneralLanguageAgent: build a GeneralLanguageAgent instance from config to execute LLM-generated task plans for robot manipulation
run_get_task_plans_from_llm: run get_task_plans_from_llm to parse LLM predictions from a JSON file into executable robot code lists
run_get_task_plans_from_oracle: run get_task_plans_from_oracle to load ground truth task plans from a dataset JSON file
test_get_taskplan_for_robot: test get_taskplan_for_robot to parse LLM function call strings into verb noun adverb step dictionaries
review_separate_into_codelist: review separate_into_codelist to split LLM-generated function call strings into individual callable steps
